outputs.explanation: The lower bar graph shows mean HMGB1 signal intensity (Nuc/Cyto) ± SD for WT, Atxn1-KI and Atxn1-KI;HMGB1 mice (N=4, n>100 cells), but only bars with error bars are shown; no individual data points (e.g., per-cell or per-animal dots) are overlaid.

The lower bar graph shows the mean % of aggregate-positive Purkinje cells ± SD (N=4 mice, n>400 cells) for each genotype, but displays only bars and error bars without the underlying individual data points.
This is a western blot image, not a quantitative plot of averaged data, so individual data points are not applicable.

This is a longitudinal time-course line plot of mean rotarod time ± SD across many weekly time points for each genotype (N=7–13 mice/group). Overlaying individual animal trajectories at every time point would be impractical/illegible, and such repeated-measures time-course summaries are conventionally presented as mean ± error without individual points.

These are time-course line plots (day1–day3 at 5, 9, and 21 weeks) of mean rotarod time ± SD for multiple groups. As with panel D, this is a repeated-measures longitudinal summary where showing individual animal points at each time point would be impractical.

This is a Kaplan–Meier survival curve, which by design already reflects each individual animal's event (death) as a step in the curve; such curves conventionally do not require additional individual data point overlays.
This panel consists of histological micrographs, not a quantitative plot of averaged data.

Both bar graphs (molecular layer thickness and Purkinje cell number) show mean ± SD for three groups with only N=3 experiments (n=9 mice/fields), a manageable number for which individual data points could easily be plotted, but only bars and error bars are shown.
